what: On first open, a small circle (24px) at the top left of the background-color curtain turns on in .25s power1.inOut, and the wordmark letters spread across the screen width at the bottom rise from 150% below in 1s power1.inOut (letter stagger total .15s). From .25s a progress ring (stroke-dashoffset) fills the circle in .5s sine, rests 1s, then the wordmark rises in 1s power2.inOut to the page’s same wordmark spot (to) and overlaps it. At that moment the curtain is removed, the reveal targets (header menu) turn on in .5s at a .05s stagger, and fx:done fires — a loader where the logo on the curtain becomes the hero title as is.

options.[data-fx-part=logo] · [data-fx-part=char: Wordmark on the curtain and its letters (letters optional)
options.[data-fx-part=ring-wrap] · [data-fx-part: Circle cell and progress ring circle (optional)
options.to: The same wordmark (css) on the page the wordmark rises to overlap — stays in place if absent
options.reveal: Things to turn on in order after the curtain lifts (css, several) — hidden at first
options.rise · stagger · fill · fill-at · wait ·: Rise length (1) · letter sequence total (.15) · loop length (.5) · loop start (.25) · rest (1) · lift length (1), in seconds — screens opened often, like apps, use shorter values
options.--fx-pad · --fx-head: Curtain edge margin (20px) · circle cell height (60px)
options.fx:done: Fired from the element when the curtain lifts — hook scroll unlock here
options.delay: Time (seconds) to wait with only the curtain laid before motion, default 0 — paradox-series about 1.15s (measured) until the app wakes and starts fetching fonts

use: B…
note: The original fills the ring as the font loads — the part draws the same shape over a fixed duration

from.where: index.html .px-load — original app-loading: .g-loading__svg-circle-wrap alpha .25 power1.inOut, .svg-logo__path y 150%→0 1s power1.inOut stagger amount .15, .g-loading__svg-spinner strokeDashoffset follows font loading progress (.25s each, the last one .5s sine), when done the logo moves to the hero logo spot over 1s power2.inOut with delay 1, curtain autoAlpha 0, header menu .5s stagger .05
